notes.title: Add Support adjust Hand and IBeam status pointer offset,fix some bugs
notes.content:
Add Support adjust Hand and IBeam status pointer offset
Fix the problem that the diagonal mouse style is not centered

notes.title: Add more global hotkey settings for quick switching of cursor styles
notes.content:
Tray icon right click popup menu > Preferences > Options > Global Hotkey
Now you can change the mouse cursor quickly while playing other games.
